import React, { useState } from "react"; const Badge = ({ count }) => <span className="badge">{count}</span>; function Panel({ title, items, onPick }) { const [open, setOpen] = useState(false); return ( <section className="panel" data-open={open}> <h2 onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}> {title} <Badge count={items.length} /> </h2> {open ? ( <ul> {items.map((item) => ( <li key={item.id} onClick={() => onPick(item)}> <a href={`/items/${item.id}`}>{item.label}</a> </li> ))} </ul> ) : null} <footer> plain text &amp; an entity <br /> </footer> </section> ); } export default function App() { return <Panel title="Things" items={[]} onPick={(x) => console.log(x)} />; }
